claim: For RDS for SQL Server gp3 volumes of 20–65,536 GiB, the baseline is 3,000 IOPS/125 MiB/s, and you can provision 3,000–80,000 IOPS and 125–2,000 MiB/s at any storage size.
question: What IOPS and throughput can RDS for SQL Server provision on gp3?

values.spoken: three thousand to eighty thousand IOPS
one hundred twenty-five to two thousand mebibytes per second

qualifiers.condition: SQL Server has no striping threshold
